source_title: What to Know About Late ‘Star Trek’ Actor Patrick Stewart’s 2 Kids, Daniel and Sophie - People.com
source_excerpt:
Bruce Glikas/FilmMagic; Dave Hogan/Getty
Patrick Stewart had two children: son Daniel and daughter Sophie
The late actor died at age 86 on Oct. 28
Daniel followed in his father’s footsteps and became an actor
Sir Patrick Stewart was a father of two.
The late Star Trek actor welcomed son Daniel and daughter Sophie with his first wife, Sheila Falconer, whom he married in 1966. The kids were born in 1967 and 1972, respectively, and Stewart and Falconer later divorced in 1990.
Stewart was married to his second wife, Wendy Neuss, from 2000 to 2003, and to his third wife, Sunny Ozell , from 2013 until his death in 2026. He died on Oct. 28 at age 86 at his home in Los Angeles after being diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy Body dementia.
While Sophie has avoided the spotlight as an adult, Daniel followed in his father’s footsteps and became an actor. Based in England, he has appeared in both American and British projects, and shared the screen with his dad three times: in a 1992 episode of Star Trek: The Next Generation , the 1993 thriller Death Train and the 2015 Starz sitcom Blunt Talk .
In the years before his death, Stewart’s relationship with his kids was “practically non-existent,” he told the Irish Independent in October 2023. “There’s not a day that goes by that I’m not pained by it,” he told the publication.
Here’s what to know about the late actor Patrick Stewart’s two children: son Daniel and daughter Sophie.
Stewart and Falconer welcomed Daniel on Oct. 20, 1967.
“I loved Daniel when he was little, and when he was a baby, I loved holding him. It was fantastic,” Stewart told PEOPLE about his firstborn’s infancy.
Daniel grew up in the world of theater — his dad was an actor and his mom is a dancer and choreographer. In April 2012, he told U.K.’s Metro newspaper that his dad “was very good at exposing his children to the artistic world,” playing them classical music and making sure books he wanted them to read were available at home.
Daniel attended a rural school outside of Stratford-upon-Avon, England, where his father was working at The Shakespeare Theatre Company, and then The Latymer School in West London, which had a “thespian bent,” he told Metro .
The year his dad began Star Trek: The Next Generation , Daniel started drama school at the California Institute of the Arts. He eventually followed in his father’s footsteps and became an actor.
“This industry and the fact that we’re both in it brings up all kinds of bizarre circumstances,” Daniel told USA Today in August 2015. “The lives we lead can be sort of ridiculous. My upbringing wasn’t a typical one in that my mum and dad came home at 5 and dinner was on the table at 6.”
Daniel’s first role came in the 1986 TV miniseries Shaka Zulu . He’s gone on to act in a number of shows, TV movies and films, including 1993’s Detonator , Law and Order: Special Victims Unit in 2001 and Silent Witness in 2020, as well as plays on and off Broadway and on London’s West End and in The Royal Shakespeare Theatre and The National Theatre.
Stewart told The Independent in December 2009 that he was “horrified” when Daniel told him that he wanted to act, adding, “I could’ve done better as a parent when my kids were little. I was just obsessed with my work and everything else took second place.”
Daniel has appeared in three projects with his famous father: an episode of Star Trek: The Next Generation , Death Train and Blunt Talk. In their episode of Star Trek: The Next Generation , which aired in 1992, Daniel played Batai, the son of Stewart’s character, in the penultimate episode of season 5, “The Inner Light.”
They also attended red carpet events together, including the 1999 premiere of The Talented Mr. Ripley in Los Angeles, the 2004 Tony Awards and the opening night after party for A Life in the Theatre in New York City in 2010.
Daniel has been married to actress Mary Stillwaggon Stewart since July 1999. They share two children, a daughter and a son.
Stewart and Falconer’s daughter, Sophie Alexandra Stewart, was born in 1972.
“When my daughter was born, it just happened to be in a time when my work was slowing down,” Stewart told PEOPLE. “The first two years of her life I was very much a caretaker because her mother was a wonderful dancer and appeared in musicals. I took over the job of being mom and dad, and I loved it. It was marvelous.”
Sophie leads a more private life than her brother, but she has made a handful of red carpet appearances over the years.
She joined Stewart, Daniel and Stewart’s then-girlfriend, Neuss, at the 44th Annual Drama Desk Awards in N.Y.C. in 1999, and she was her dad’s date to the 2003 premiere of 2 Fast 2 Furious and the 2009 Laurence Olivier Awards, both in London. She also turned out for the premiere of Star Trek: Nemesis in London in 2002.
In March 2022, Stewart told PEOPLE that both Sophie and Daniel encouraged and “teased” him about his initial Star Trek audition.
“ They thought it was hysterical that I was even auditioning ,” the famed actor told PEOPLE in March 2022. “They told me, ‘Dad, we used to watch [the original] every night!’ I said, ‘The guys wearing the colored T-shirts?’ That was all I knew about it.”
